extracted.name: Johnsonville Italian Sausage, Onions & Peppers Skillet
extracted.description: This Johnsonville Italian sausage, onions & peppers skillet recipe combines Italian sausage slices with sautéed bell peppers, onions, and diced tomatoes.
ingredient_lines: 1 (22 ounce) package frozen Johnsonville® Mild Italian Sausage Slices
1 medium green bell pepper, thinly sliced
1 medium red bell pepper, thinly sliced
1 (14.5 ounce) can diced tomatoes with basil, garlic and oregano
instruction_lines: Cook sausage, onion, peppers, and garlic in oil in a large skillet until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes and pepper flakes; cook and stir until heated through, about 5 minutes.
